method: Authorized Computer Use operated and observed the actual built Tauri renderer/IPC and owned Windows Shell dialogs. Booleans below were evaluated against fresh accessibility trees; visual focus observations are labelled separately. Native event records came from the isolated fixture stdout. Raw Shell navigation/account paths and screenshots are not published.

cases.acceptanceBoundary: AC5/AC6 actual lock while native chooser is pending
visualObservations: Tab focused Change folder and Return opened the owned system dialog.
After automatic lock the dialog disappeared without Escape, Cancel or any other operator intervention.
cases.operatorCleanup: Alt+F4 closed only the remaining locked synthetic shell; Unlock was never invoked.

cases.acceptanceBoundary: AC5/AC6 main-window close while native chooser is pending
AC1/AC2/AC3/AC4/AC6 ordinary actual folder selection and cancellation
visualObservations: Default parent was selected before dialog use; entering the friendly name Crème Field Study generated creme-field-study without a directory-name input.
Tab/Return opened the owned picker; Escape cancelled it, preserving the visible name and default destination and restoring the visible focus ring to Change folder.
Return from restored focus reopened the actual picker. The operator selected the precreated empty Étude 数据 🧪 folder from the list, without typing a path.
The separate Open picker used the existing-project purpose title; confirming its folder choice enabled explicit Open but did not open a project.
cases.readOnlyFilesystemCheck: After app shutdown the verified synthetic parent contained only the one precreated Unicode directory, which was still empty. Neither selection nor cancellation created a project.

correction: Queue documented WM_CLOSE to the exact IOleWindow dialog HWND after validating current process and STA ownership. Sticky cancellation and late-result suppression remain authoritative; no private Shell message or offset is shipped.
scopeLimits: Working-source observations require final Git/source binding and independent disposition; this is not task completion.
No actual credential or production policy action was exercised. Fresh-unlock clearing has separate renderer/native fixture evidence.
The GUI default parent is substituted. Separate actual default-parent Core creation and production packaging/whole-Wave qualification remain required.
